svg.title: DSM Offline Anchor — Sheet 1 — Wiring & Pinout
svg.text: Six wires, soldered directly into the plated holes. No headers, no other parts.
component side up · USB toward top
GP17 as push-pull GPIO, driven by firmware
3.3 V ONLY. Never connect VBUS or VSYS (5 V) to the Click.
No pin headers. Solder each wire straight into the plated
hole on both boards — headers will not fit the pocket case.
Leave GPO, every NC pad and the Snap pads unconnected.
Do not snap off the Click Snap module; the case is sized
28–30 AWG stranded silicone wire, 60–80 mm per lead.
*Colours are a suggestion; signal names govern.
Boards are drawn side by side for clarity. Installed, the
Click lies under the Pico (see Sheet 2).
CLICK: insert from the COMPONENT SIDE
The Click rests on 3.5 mm ledges (1.9 mm above the floor).
Component outlines on both boards are indicative.
Pin names and pad positions are exact.
Pocket case REV E · base.stl / lid.stl
mm · drawings not to scale unless noted
